messages:
maya: Heads-up — renewal for NovaCorps looks risky. They reported tokenization mismatch + latency spikes after the v2 rollout. Escalation INC-2458 opened. Who can pick up triage? Need ETA before Monday so finance can decide on renewal terms.

aj: I'm on it, saw the incident. Quick clarifying q: are they on Dedicated or Hosted? If dedicated, which region/cluster?

julia: They're on Dedicated (NOVAC-17) in us-west-2. Problem shows up during nightly batch embedding jobs (~2AM local). Customer says timeouts and OOMs.

aj: ok thanks. I can reproduce a smaller run locally — hitting OOM when sequence length >2048. Looks like quantized kernel fallback is causing a mem spike.

peter: I pushed a temporary staging config that pins the kernel and raises memory headroom: `RT_MEM_LIMIT=32g` + `--use-kernel=stable`. Config snippet:
```
models:
  nova-embed:
    kv_cache: enabled
    quantize: int8
```
Can CS ask them to try staging?

julia: I'll coordinate. Scheduling a quick test call with the customer at 9am PT Monday. Maya — can you handle messaging to finance about potential delay to renewal?

maya: Yep — I'll tell finance we have an escalation and a mitigation path. Also we need a rollback plan and docs update for customers using batch embeddings. @aj can you open a PR with rollback steps + a short migration note?

aj: Will do. Drafting PR now (branch: fix/embed-oom-1775). Need @peter to confirm kernel pin details for the PR.

peter: Reviewing the PR draft — I added a note about perf tradeoffs and fallback detection. If this doesn't fully resolve before renewal, propose offering a one-month credit + extended trial while we root-cause.

deploy-bot: deployment 1775124780: staging configuration applied to nova-embed/node-3 :white_check_mark: 

julia: Customer agreed to run a test on staging in ~45m. If green, they'll greenlight a hotfix push to their Dedicated cluster.

maya: Blockers summary: need PR + docs update + customer test result by EOD. Anyone else with blockers? :thinking_face:

aj: No blockers from infra side, just need a quick review on the PR.

peter: No blockers, will finish review now.

julia: I'll post test results here when I have them.

maya: Thanks — please ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
